The house

Light, held quietly.

Aura & Majesty is a fictional demonstration maison. It is not a registered jeweller, and it does not claim a street, a vault or a client book.

The work on this page follows a single idea: a jewel should feel like a continuation of the person who wears it — tenderness, light and exact geometry, without noise.

Light

Metal and stone are composed so the facet carries the colour, not the setting.

Hand

The language of the house is hand-finishing: quiet surfaces, small tolerances, no ornament that does not earn its place.

Rarity

The three pieces are presented as limited works of a fictional house — not as certified editions, and not as stock that can be ordered.

Craft

The bench, imagined with discipline.

A real atelier would be a room of benches, stones and time. This page does not pretend that room exists, and it does not display certificates.

What it does show is the standard the house would hold: metal of a stated fineness, stones described plainly, and a form that can be read at a glance.

  • Compositions described in plain language, without invented grades.
  • No GIA, HRD or other certificate is claimed for these pieces.
  • Care, polishing and repair are not offered — there is no workshop behind this page.

Appointments

A private viewing, as a demonstration.

In a working maison, a private viewing is a seated appointment with the piece in hand. Here the form only rehearses that gesture. It does not reserve a chair, a city or a time.

No boutique address is published, because none is real.

Correspondence

Contact

No telephone number and no email address are invented for this demonstration. When the owner publishes the house, those details belong here — and only if they are real.

Before any commercial publication

An Impressum and a privacy policy are not included. German legal notices in particular need the owner’s actual company name, address, representative and contact. Those facts are missing on purpose.
